summary.name: JPEGmini
summary.one_liner: JPEGmini is a paid image and video compressor for Mac and Windows that reduces JPEG, HEIC, and video file sizes while aiming to preserve quality.
use_cases: reduce photo file sizes before sharing or uploading
compress images inside Lightroom or Photoshop without exporting
automate processing of new files in watch folders
summary.what_it_does: The page describes JPEGmini as a tool that reduces image size by up to 80% without compromising quality, as stated in the listing. It supports JPEG to JPEG and HEIC to JPEG optimization, batch processing, and 512MP panorama files. The paid Pro tier adds H264/H265 video compression and resize and export. Pro + Plugins adds Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, and Capture One plugins, and Pro + Automations adds watch folders, background processing, and batch presets.
notable: Plugins for Lightroom, Photoshop, and Capture One that optimize without exporting
Watch folders and batch presets for automated processing
Free 7-day full Pro trial, then a limited free tier
caveats: Free tier is limited to 50 images per day and video only during the trial
Plugins and automations require the higher-priced bundles ($89, $99, or $129)
Pro is a one-time purchase at $59 covering 3 devices
